whatIs: BGJar generates SVG backgrounds for sites, blogs, and apps. It offers 35 styles (waves, hexagons, circuit boards, stars, snow, and more), each with its own customization page.
It's a good fit when you want a lightweight vector background that scales to any size without losing sharpness.
uses: Using a wave background in a blog's header.
Giving a technical product's landing page a circuit background.
Generating an SVG texture for an app's welcome screen.
caveats: The free plan requires attribution; to remove it you have to pay for the Basic plan (one project) or Pro (unlimited projects).
On the free plan, files are licensed under CC BY 4.0; on all plans, it's prohibited to resell or give away the backgrounds as-is and to use them to build a service similar to BGJar.
A very detailed SVG can be quite heavy; check the file size before using it as a background.
pricingNote: Free with attribution; Basic costs $5.99 and Pro $35.99, both one-time payments.
idealFor: Anyone who needs varied SVG backgrounds and is willing to give attribution or pay once.
